title: Nobody under a raised load
explanation_template: Person under a raised load at {time}.
unsupported: "Under the load" is a vertical relation: the person must stand below the raised forks. None of the primitives expresses it: distance_lt measures distance along the floor between ground contact points, and a load held in the air has no ground contact point to measure from. height_above_floor can tell that the load is above 1.5 m, but not who is beneath it.
suggested_rewrite: Nobody within 1 m of a forklift while its load is raised above 1.5 m.
